Lower Text: [End of Attack][Once Per Turn] By returning 3 cards with [Jellymon] in their texts from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order, unsuspend this Digimon.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] You may trash up to 2 blue cards in your hand. For each card trashed by this effect, you may choose 1 card under an opponent’s Digimon or Tamer and trash it. Then, 1 of your opponent’s Digimon or Tamers without cards under it can’t be suspended until the end of their next turn.
